title: SDIO card (function 1, 4-bit bus): CMD52 IO_RW_DIRECT and CMD53 IO_RW_EXTENDED (byte mode, incrementing or fixed address) over a 128 x 8 register file, R5 responses with error flags, CRC7, CRC16 data blocks and CRC status tokens

irqs.name: ERR
irqs.desc: a command was dropped (bad CRC7, bad framing, unsupported index or block mode) or a data block was discarded (bad CRC16 or end bits, no write block within 64 clocks)

notes: sd_clk (in), cmd and dat[3:0] (bidirectional, need pull-ups) are the SDIO bus; they pass through unchanged. The card runs on sd_clk; sd_clk must be synchronous to PCLK and at most PCLK / 2 so that every error pulse is seen.
The register file is reached over the SDIO bus only; the registers report the card's error events.
